title: storyblok-backup: Stored path traversal via unsanitized Storyblok component names in backup output (CVE-2026-115565)
description: storyblok-backup versions prior to 0.7.1 contain a stored path traversal vulnerability. This occurs because component names, which are user-editable and unsanitized, are used directly as filenames during backup creation. An attacker with component management access can craft a component name with path traversal sequences to cause files to be written outside the intended backup directory when the backup tool is run. This can lead to arbitrary file writes on the backup host machine.
